messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-06-06, the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node. [decision; valid 2025-06-06 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-06-06]
- The job scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009. [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- As of 2025-09-30, the billing API will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. [decision; valid 2025-09-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-30]
- Ownership of the job scheduler transferred from the Dune team to the Cinder team on 2025-09-23. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19]
    earlier: Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06]
- Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request. [constraint; valid 2025-04-02 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-02]
- As of 2025-05-15, the pager for webhooks rings the Boreal team instead of the Ember team. [valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-05-15-webhooks]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-03, the pager for webhooks rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team. [valid 2025-03-03 to 2025-05-15; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
- As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
- The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, during the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- On 2026-05-22, the Dune team observed that the job scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22-3]
- At the Cinder standup on 2026-01-30, it was decided that authentication gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. [decision; valid 2026-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-30]
- The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not the Dune team. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- The Cinder team owns the job scheduler as of 2025-09-23, when ownership transferred from the Dune team. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
    earlier: The Dune team owns the job scheduler as of 2025-09-05. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-05]
- From 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 there are no deploys to the ledger service because of the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11]
- The Dune team adopted a monthly game day as of 2025-04-21. [decision; valid 2025-04-21 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-21]
- The job scheduler is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-25, when ownership moved from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-scheduler]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- The job scheduler depends on the feature-flags service. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-29]
- The Ember team is a one-person team consisting of Oskar. [valid 2025-01-10 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-10]

Question: Why did the scheduler switch to leader election instead of a single fixed node?

message.reasoning:

- "As of 2025-06-06, the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node. [decision; valid 2025-06-06 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-06-06]"

There's a decision about leader election, but no reason stated for that decision. The ten-second lease entry has a reason ("two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009"), but that's about shortening the lease, not about adopting leader election.

So the memory does not contain the reason for switching to leader election. Answer: "I don't know"
